extracts.fact: Economy LT includes 5kg cabin baggage, no checked bag, no voluntary refund; FL includes 5kg cabin baggage and one 23kg checked bag. LT/FL changes and FL refunds before check-in closes have fees from RUB5000. Special subsidised fares can sit outside brands.
Cabin baggage limit is 55x40x20cm; included checked piece dimension total is at most203cm. Brand baggage allowances are general policy only.
Section9 gives general airport passenger/baggage check-in closure40min before scheduled departure, with possible exceptions by route; section9.1 places boarding deadline on the boarding pass.
Carrier FAQ states airport check-in opens2h before departure and closes40min before departure.
